title: 事实细节题
goal: 定位明确事实，核对对象、时间和程度等限定条件。

points.label: 定位题目所问的明确事实
核对选项中的对象和限定条件

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 阅读理解能力的课程安排

body.p: 事实细节题考原文明确写出的信息。题干可能问原因、对象、时间或条件。

body.box:
According to the passage, why did the team change its schedule?
What does the passage say about the afternoon session?
Which of the following was NOT included?

body.p: 否定问法要选出与原文不符的一项。核对时，把选项的对象、动作和范围逐一对照原文。

steps.d: 找出题干的对象、动作和限定词。题干问 afternoon session，先把它和上午场分开。
在原文找对象的名称或同义表达，读完这一句和前后两句。代词所指的对象常在前一句。
逐项比较选项的对象、时间、数量和否定范围。否定题要确认其余三项都符合原文。

cards.title: 细节的三种情况
rows: The committee chose a hall. It had a ramp.
Mina brought two maps. She lent them to Ali.
The box held pens and paper, but no rulers.
The tour includes the garden, not the roof.

body.box: The gallery offered morning tours in June. In July it added an afternoon tour, but the morning tour remained available. Only the afternoon tour included the sculpture room.

According to the passage, which tour included the sculpture room?
1. The morning tour in June
2. The afternoon tour in July
3. Every tour offered in July
4. The morning tour in July

body.p: 末句的 Only the afternoon tour 指定下午场。前一句说下午场是七月新增的，所以第二项符合原文。
第三项忽略了 Only 的范围。七月仍有上午场，但上午场不含雕塑室。

cards.title: 干扰项
rows: 把六月上午场当作七月下午场
核对 only 所限定的场次
把不含屋顶理解为没有花园
把一些访客写成所有访客

groups.text: The outdoor meeting moved to the hall because rain was expected. The exhibition remained under a shelter.

options: The exhibition needed the hall.
Rain was expected that day.
The shelter had been removed.
The meeting ended before the rain.
items.why: because rain was expected 直接说明会议迁移的原因。

groups.text: A group borrowed a projector. It was returned to the office on Tuesday.

options: A projector the office borrowed
The group's own projector
The projector the group borrowed
A new projector bought on Tuesday
items.why: It 回指前句的 a projector，即小组借来的投影仪，第三项正确。第一项把借出和借入的一方弄反了。

groups.text: The fee covers paper and pencils, but it does not cover paint. Brushes are supplied separately.

items.stem: Which item is NOT covered by the fee?
options: Paper used in the class
Pencils used in the class
The paper and pencils together
Paint used in the class
items.why: does not cover paint 明确排除颜料。

groups.text: Some visitors attended the Friday talk. All registered volunteers attended the Saturday meeting.

items.stem: What does the passage say about the Friday talk?
options: Some visitors attended the talk.
Every visitor attended the talk.
All volunteers attended the talk.
No visitors attended the talk.
items.why: Some visitors attended the Friday talk 限定了人数范围；all 修饰的是周六会议的志愿者。

groups.text: A neighborhood center ordered new folding chairs in March. It stored them in a side room until the floor in the main hall was repaired in April. The old chairs remained in the meeting room. Only the new chairs were used for the first event in the repaired hall.

items.stem: Where were the new chairs stored before the hall was repaired?
options: In the main hall
In a side room
In the meeting room
At the first event
items.why: It stored them in a side room 中 them 指前句的新折叠椅。

items.stem: Which chairs were used for the first event in the repaired hall?
options: Both the old and the new chairs
The old chairs from the meeting room
Only the newly ordered chairs
The new chairs and some old ones
items.why: Only the new chairs were used 明确限定首次活动使用的新椅子。

groups.text:
A town's community kitchen offers residents a place to prepare food for local events. Last winter, the building's heating system needed repairs, so the kitchen closed for several weeks. During that period, a nearby school allowed the town to use its kitchen on Saturday mornings. The school kitchen was unavailable on weekdays because classes were held there.

When the community kitchen reopened in March, the town introduced a booking system. Groups could request a time online or leave a message at the town office. Staff confirmed each booking after checking that the kitchen was free. The system covered the kitchen itself, but it did not include the adjoining dining room, which had a separate schedule.

In April, staff reviewed the first month of bookings. Most groups had used the online form, while a smaller number had left messages at the office. Staff kept both methods because some residents preferred to speak with someone. They also posted a printed schedule beside the kitchen door. This showed confirmed bookings for the current week, but it did not show requests that were still awaiting confirmation.

items.stem: Why did the community kitchen close last winter?
options: Its heating system needed repair.
The school needed it for weekday classes.
Its dining room had no schedule.
The online booking form was unavailable.
items.why: heating system needed repairs, so the kitchen closed 直接说明关闭原因。

items.stem: What did the town's new booking system cover?
options: Both the kitchen and the dining room
The dining room and its separate schedule
The kitchen only, not the room next to it
The school kitchen on Saturday mornings
items.why: 原文说 covered the kitchen itself, but it did not include the adjoining dining room。第三项把 adjoining dining room 改写为 the room next to it。

items.stem: Which requests appeared on the printed schedule?
options: All requests awaiting confirmation
Confirmed bookings for the current week
Every request made during the winter closure
Only requests left at the town office
items.why: This 回指 printed schedule，后句指出其显示本周已确认的预订。

groups.text:
A university department maintains a collection of recordings made by former students. For many years, visitors listened to them on equipment in a small room. The equipment was still working, but the room could accommodate only a few people at once. The department therefore decided to make copies of selected recordings available at a second listening station.

Before moving any material, staff checked the condition of the original recordings. Copies were prepared in a different room, and the originals remained in secure storage. The new station opened in the department's reading area in September. Visitors could listen there without reserving a time, although anyone wishing to examine an original recording still needed an appointment.

In October, staff asked users about the new arrangement. Some appreciated being able to listen without booking ahead. Others wanted written descriptions of the recordings before choosing one. The department began preparing descriptions for the second station. It kept the small room open as well, since its equipment was needed for recordings that had not yet been copied. The department planned to review the descriptions after users had had time to try them.

items.stem: Why did the department add a second listening station?
options: The original equipment had stopped working.
The reading area had closed in September.
Staff needed space to check the originals.
The existing room held only a few listeners.
items.why: the room could accommodate only a few people at once 是增设播放位置的原因。

items.stem: What could visitors do without an appointment?
options: Remove original recordings from storage
Hear copied recordings at the new station
Examine any original in secure storage
Listen to originals in the reading area
items.why: 原文说 Visitors could listen there without reserving a time，there 指阅览区的新播放位置，那里放的是复制件，即第二项。原件仍要预约。

items.stem: Which recordings still required the equipment in the small room?
options: Recordings that had not yet been copied
Only recordings described in writing
Every copy played at the second station
Recordings chosen for the second station
items.why: its equipment was needed for recordings that had not yet been copied 明确限定录音范围。
